column1: # --- aturan jaminan Doll ---
=In this access type, every 10 accesses guarantees a Standard Doll, Weapon, or Elite Doll.
column2: Di tipe access ini, tiap 10 access dijamin mendapat Standard Doll, Weapon, atau Elite Doll.

column1: =In this access type, if an Elite Doll is not obtained within 58 consecutive accesses, the probability of obtaining an Elite Doll increases with each subsequent access.
column2: Di tipe access ini, kalau Elite Doll tidak didapat dalam 58 access berturut-turut, probabilitas mendapat Elite Doll naik tiap access berikutnya.

column1: =After 80 accesses, an Elite Doll is guaranteed.
column2: Setelah 80 access, Elite Doll dijamin didapat.

column1: =Once an Elite Doll is obtained, the count is reset, and the probability of obtaining an Elite Doll returns to the base rate.
column2: Begitu Elite Doll didapat, hitungannya direset dan probabilitas mendapat Elite Doll kembali ke rate dasar.

column1: =If the Elite Doll obtained is not the boosted Elite Doll of the current event, the next Elite Doll obtained will be the boosted Elite Doll of the current event.
column2: Kalau Elite Doll yang didapat bukan Elite Doll yang di-boost di event ini, Elite Doll berikutnya dipastikan yang di-boost di event ini.

column1: =If the Elite Doll obtained is not the featured Elite Doll of the current event, the next Elite Doll obtained will be the featured Elite Doll of the current event.
column2: Kalau Elite Doll yang didapat bukan Elite Doll unggulan di event ini, Elite Doll berikutnya dipastikan yang unggulan di event ini.

column1: =The guarantee counter for this access type does not accumulate and is independent of other access types, having no mutual effect.
column2: Hitungan jaminan tipe access ini tidak terakumulasi dan terpisah dari tipe access lain, tanpa saling memengaruhi.

column1: =In this access type, each time a retired weapon is obtained, you will receive 2 Withdrawal Receipts; each time a Standard Doll or Weapon is obtained, you will receive 12 Redundant Pieces; each time an Elite Doll or Weapon is obtained, you will receive 60 Redundant Pieces.
column2: Di tipe access ini, tiap kali retired weapon didapat, kamu menerima 2 Withdrawal Receipts; tiap kali Standard Doll atau Weapon didapat, kamu menerima 12 Redundant Pieces; tiap kali Elite Doll atau Weapon didapat, kamu menerima 60 Redundant Pieces.

column1: # --- konversi Doll ganda ---
=Regardless of how a duplicate Doll is obtained (including but not limited to access, exchange, event, etc.), the following conversion rules will apply:
column2: Bagaimanapun Doll ganda didapat (termasuk tapi tidak terbatas pada access, penukaran, event, dsb.), aturan konversi berikut berlaku:

column1: =1) When a duplicate Standard Doll is obtained, the 2nd to 7th times will convert into 30 corresponding Doll Neural Archives; from the 8th time onward, they will convert into 18 Redundant Pieces.
column2: 1) Saat Standard Doll ganda didapat, perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7 dikonversi jadi 30 Doll Neural Archives terkait; mulai perolehan ke-8, dikonversi jadi 18 Redundant Pieces.

column1: =2) When a duplicate Elite Doll is obtained, the 2nd to 7th times will convert into 30 corresponding Doll Neural Archives; from the 8th time onward, they will convert into 90 Redundant Pieces.
column2: 2) Saat Elite Doll ganda didapat, perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7 dikonversi jadi 30 Doll Neural Archives terkait; mulai perolehan ke-8, dikonversi jadi 90 Redundant Pieces.

column1: =2) When a duplicate Elite Doll is obtained, the 2nd to 7th times will convert into 30 corresponding Doll Neural Archives; from the 8th time onward, they will convert into 90 Redundant Pieces."
column2: 2) Saat Elite Doll ganda didapat, perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7 dikonversi jadi 30 Doll Neural Archives terkait; mulai perolehan ke-8, dikonversi jadi 90 Redundant Pieces."

column1: =When a duplicate Standard Doll is obtained, the 2nd to 7th times will convert into 30 corresponding Doll Neural Archives; from the 8th time onward, they will convert into 18 Redundant Pieces.
column2: Saat Standard Doll ganda didapat, perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7 dikonversi jadi 30 Doll Neural Archives terkait; mulai perolehan ke-8, dikonversi jadi 18 Redundant Pieces.

column1: =When a duplicate Elite Doll is obtained, the 2nd to 7th times will convert into 30 corresponding Doll Neural Archives; from the 8th time onward, they will convert into 90 Redundant Pieces.
column2: Saat Elite Doll ganda didapat, perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7 dikonversi jadi 30 Doll Neural Archives terkait; mulai perolehan ke-8, dikonversi jadi 90 Redundant Pieces.

column1: # ============ varian senjata: "type of Access" ============

=In this type of Access, the base probability of obtaining an Elite Weapon is <color=#EDA51C>{0}{1}{2}</color>, and the comprehensive probability of obtaining an Elite Weapon (including the guarantee) is <color=#EDA51C>{3}</color>.
column2: Di tipe Access ini, probabilitas dasar mendapat Elite Weapon adalah <color=#EDA51C>{0}{1}{2}</color>, dan probabilitas menyeluruh mendapat Elite Weapon (termasuk jaminan) adalah <color=#EDA51C>{3}</color>.

column1: =In this type of Access, the base probability of obtaining a Standard Weapon is <color=#AC65E8>{4}{5}{6}</color>, and the comprehensive probability of obtaining a Standard Weapon (including the guarantee) is <color=#AC65E8>{7}</color>.
column2: Di tipe Access ini, probabilitas dasar mendapat Standard Weapon adalah <color=#AC65E8>{4}{5}{6}</color>, dan probabilitas menyeluruh mendapat Standard Weapon (termasuk jaminan) adalah <color=#AC65E8>{7}</color>.

column1: =In this type of Access, if an Elite Weapon is not obtained in 50 consecutive Accesses, the probability of obtaining an Elite Weapon will increase, and every 70 Accesses guarantees obtaining an Elite Weapon.
column2: Di tipe Access ini, kalau Elite Weapon tidak didapat dalam 50 Access berturut-turut, probabilitas mendapat Elite Weapon akan naik, dan tiap 70 Access dijamin mendapat Elite Weapon.
